fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks/... passes (no broken relative link in the real README.md and docs/) and make self-check passes (rhiza check's docs-commands rule finds no rhiza command in README.md or docs/ that does not exist), README.md no longer says pages are on the way, and the owner approves the page at the run's sign-off
fields.statement: README.md reads in the owner's voice (drafted with the humanize skill) and its where-next section links the docs that exist (quickstart, concepts, agents, runs and the daemon, custom workflows, the generated reference) instead of saying they are on the way
